messages:
harper_csm: Heads-up from the weekly health run: detected a short hosted-API spend flare this morning ~09:08 UTC. anomaly_score 0.95. three accounts flagged.

mira_data: quick results: flux-org peak ~3.6x baseline for ~11m, orbit-inc ~2.1x, ivy-labs ~1.7x. query used: 
```sql
SELECT org, sum(tokens) AS tokens, max(tokens_per_min) AS peak_tpm
FROM hosted_usage
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T09:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T09:20:00Z'
GROUP BY org ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 5;
```

zac_ops: infra check: we rolled a small canary routing tweak in us-west at 09:02 — no autoscaler alerts. will grep gateway for 429s.

watchdog_bot: alert: short_window_spend_flare detected for [flux-org, orbit-inc, ivy-labs]. score=0.95. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/spend-flare

toni_fin: provisional exposure if sustained: flux-org ~$11.6k vs commit $3.2k. marking "high-variance" for reconciliation.

harper_csm: CSM owners please prepare outreach if finance confirms material exposure. prefer to call before billing goes out if we can.

mira_data: traces show a burst of new streaming sessions for flux-org during the window; error rate flat. looks client-driven. request_ids exported now (DMing harper).

zac_ops: grep results: tiny 429 bump 09:05-09:10 UTC mapping to flux-org IDs, likely client fanout + transient rate pressure. no 5xx.

toni_fin: finance prefers handling credits case-by-case. suggested goodwill cap $2k for flux-org if customer reports surprise.

harper_csm: Action items: 1) mira to share CSV of request/session ids and mark retries (ETA 90m). 2) zac to add temporary rate-smoothing to canary pool (ETA 30m). 3) toni to draft credit guidance (ETA EOD). 4) harper to draft outreach template (ETA EOD).

mira_data: DM sent with export. flagged which sessions had retries. :mag:

zac_ops: rate-smoothing override applied to canary routes, monitoring 30m. :gear:

billingbot: provisional estimate for flux-org if spike persists = $11,600. awaiting finalization.

harper_csm: Thanks team. I'll keep this thread as the single source for reconciliation notes and the outreach copy. Also adding a short-window detector (5-20m) to next week's pack so these flares surface earlier. :white_check_mark:
